title: Basalt (Inkling 2 Mini) — CUDA Hierarchy Efficiency: Prefill vs Decode
subtitle: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 72GB GDDR7 (sm_120, 110 SMs, 300W) | CUDA 13.4 | Identifying Regime Bottlenecks
footer: Green (>=80%): Near Hardware Ceiling  •  Amber (55–79%): Tunable Headroom  •  Red (<55%): Primary Bottleneck  •  Slate: Inactive
focus_banner: Regime Contrast: Prefill is Tensor-Core & SMEM-Pipeline Bound • Decode is Weight-VRAM, Launch-Tail & KV-Coalescing Bound

smem_l1.headline: Bank-Free: ~100% • 128B/64B XOR
smem_l1.detail: 100 KiB carveout (28 KiB L1 safe via TMA/.cg) • 4-stage far KV

warp_simt.headline: SIMT Eff: ~95% • Tile-Hoisted Mask
warp_simt.detail: 0 inner-loop int64%cap • Branchless whole-tile causal softmax

host_pcie.headline: VRAM-Resident (0 B PCIe)
host_pcie.detail: Spilled mode: 9KB DtoH overlapped w/ router + float4 SYS merge

global_vram.headline: q8_planes: 85% BW • NVFP4 AoS: 41% BW
global_vram.detail: 36B block_nvfp4 forces LDG.32 (549 GB/s); q8_planes hits 1.16 TB/s
global_vram.diagnosis: 36B AoS block_nvfp4 breaks 16B alignment in native_down_sub8<40> (41% DRAM BW).
global_vram.action: Repack NVFP4 into 128B-aligned planar SoA to unlock LDG.128 (uint4).

l2_cache.headline: Inter-Kernel Act Warm in L2
l2_cache.detail: 9–36 KB token activations stay L2-resident across layer visits

smem_l1.headline: Low SMEM (0–49 KiB) • L1=64–128 KiB
smem_l1.detail: attn.cu cp.async V cached in L1; MMVQ uses warp shuffles

regs_occ.headline: 0 B Spill • Glue Storm: ~28% Time
regs_occ.detail: Multiple 3–6 us micro-kernels/visit create grid-drain bubbles
regs_occ.diagnosis: 9 micro-kernels per visit (~3–6 us each) spend ~25–32% of Decode in launch/tail drain.

warp_simt.headline: 432 PRMT LUT Ops in NVFP4 Split<40>
warp_simt.detail: Branchless dp4a in Q8, but FP4 nibble LUT burns SIMT ALU cycles
warp_simt.diagnosis: 432 PRMT byte-permutes in llama.cpp-style FP4 LUT dequantization.
warp_simt.action: Replace PRMT LUT with native sm_120a `cvt.rn.f16x2.e2m1x2` (`F2FP`).

compute_cores.headline: T=1: SIMT dp4a/FFMA • T>=4: m16n8k32
compute_cores.detail: M=1..3 underfills m16 Tensor Core rows; gated by weight DRAM BW
